title: data.json — the baked artifact (version 1)
description: The machine half of data-json.md (RULES rule 7): the shape the bake writes. bake/emit.py imports and validates against this before writing — a violation is a bake bug. The page owns why/when; this file owns shape. Closed at every level: the field table is the complete list of what the artifact carries.

x-not-schema-shaped.CIR-BAKE-SELF-CONTAINED: a property of index.html (inlined copy, no fetch), not of this file's shape
x-not-schema-shaped.CIR-BAKE-ATOMIC-WRITE: publishing discipline (temp file + rename, mode 0644) — behaviour of the write, not shape
x-not-schema-shaped.CIR-BAKE-DETERMINISM: same inputs → same bytes: a property across two bakes
x-not-schema-shaped.CIR-BAKE-EXPOSURE: what a warning message may say (sanitized, bounded) — content, and the spec names no numeric cap
x-not-schema-shaped.CIR-BAKE-PAGE-DOES-NOT-RESOLVE: a property of the page's code, not of the artifact

version.description: Integer artifact-schema version, currently 1; bumped on any breaking shape change.

spec_version.description: The config format version this bake read.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the bake run — the honesty stamp, displayed verbatim.

reference_date.description: The single ISO date every adapter aged against.

timezone.description: The IANA zone the reference date was computed in.

stale_after_hours.description: The page banners itself stale past this age; null at P0, where no cadence exists (⚖-R15).

rings.description: Config order preserved (inside-out); ring/item ids and labels pass through.

warnings.description: Always present, possibly empty — never omitted.

status.description: Wire values, not display words and never emoji (⚖-R19).

grey_reason.description: Why an item is grey; null whenever status is not grey (⚖-R50).

guardrail.description: null when absent in config — no placeholder strings.

link.description: Passes through from config: https?:// or root-relative, else null.

last_data_date.description: ISO date, present only when the adapter observed one.

detail_line.description: The composed one-line summary, baked — authoritative over page-side composition (⚖-R20).

detail_page.description: Path of the per-item detail payload (details/<ring-id>--<item-id>.json, ⚖-R34), else null (P2).

allOf.description: grey_reason is set exactly when status is grey.

item.description: The <ring>/<item> ref, null for config-level warnings.
